properties.name: consumption
properties.purpose:
What the design built and nothing in the design consumes. Refuses to say 'unused' where recording a consumer is not the design's habit — the ratio is the finding, not the count.

DISTINCT FROM epoch:built-and-consumed-by-nothing, chg:consumption-detector-built — read and judged different in KIND. Those are the capability or requirement this module serves; this is the module itself. A part and the thing it is for are not the same node, and collapsing them would leave the design unable to say which of the two moved.
